en: The postcard shows a historical scene of soldiers disembarking from boats onto a wooden pier. There are several boats in the water and the pier stretches into the sea. The foreground has a lamp post and what appears to be a stone or brick structure. Many people, including armed soldiers, can be seen on the pier. The image is monochrome and has a vintage appearance. At the top, printed text identifies the place and event depicted.
